SELECT id, sku, name, description, price, stock, category, image_url, featured FROM products WHERE active = TRUE
AND (name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND category = #{category}
ORDER BY featured DESC, created_at DESC
SELECT id, sku, name, description, price, stock, category, image_url, featured FROM products WHERE id = #{id} AND active = TRUE
SELECT DISTINCT category FROM products WHERE active = TRUE ORDER BY category
